channel.title: Machinery: Korean small and mid-cap filings
channel.description: New filings from Korean small and mid-cap companies in the machinery sector.

item.title: Neosem: Neosem signed a KRW 14.21bn semiconductor test equipment supply contract with its subsidiary Neosem Technology Inc., equal to 22.2% of recent revenue.
GigaVis: GigaVis signed a KRW 38.8bn contract to supply semiconductor substrate repair equipment and other items to a Korean substrate manufacturer.
Intekplus: Intekplus signed a KRW 14.6bn contract to supply semiconductor and substrate inspection equipment to takewin International Ltd for China.
Robotis: ROBOTIS signed a KRW 3.98bn DYNAMIXEL-X supply contract with Pollen Robotics SAS of France, 10.22% of recent revenue.
Jeil M&S: Jeil M&S decides to issue KRW 2.0bn Series 3 private convertible bonds for working capital under its court-approved rehabilitation plan.
STX Engine: STX Engine signed a KRW 66.5bn contract with Defense Acquisition Program Administration for coastal surveillance radar-II initial mass production and 25 other items.
Narae Nanotech: Narae Nanotech signed a KRW 6.49bn display manufacturing equipment supply contract with BOE Display Technology for delivery in China.
Woniltni: Woniltni signed a KRW 4.39bn contract with Hanwha Power to supply a heater-performance skid retrofit, 14.82% of recent revenue.
GigaVis: GigaVis signed a KRW 44.7bn contract to supply semiconductor substrate inspection and repair equipment to a Chinese substrate manufacturer.
Woojin Plaimm: Woojin Plaimm reported Q3 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 60.2bn and operating profit of KRW 3.7bn, with a net loss.
Hwacheon Machinery: Hwacheon Machinery Q3 2026 preliminary revenue rose 14.5% YoY to KRW 61.7bn, with an operating loss of KRW 274mn.
HD-Hyundai Marine Engine: HD Hyundai Marine Engine signed a KRW 36.1bn marine engine supply contract with Samsung Heavy Industries, equal to 9.0% of revenue.
Model Solution: Model Solution reported Q3 2026 preliminary revenue of KRW 20.4bn and operating profit of KRW 1.3bn, down 60.46% YoY.
Taesung: Taesung's board resolved on Nov 5, 2026 to issue KRW 70.0bn of 0% private-placement convertible bonds due Nov 19, 2031.
TYM: TYM reported Q3 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 260.1bn and operating profit of KRW 35.8bn, up 124.7% year on year.
SNTEnergy: SNT Energy reported Q3 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 100.8bn and operating profit of KRW 17.6bn, with a net loss of KRW 7.4bn.
